ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first diagnostic pre-screener and health awareness agent tailored for rural Indian dialects, bridging the gap between local symptoms and preventive care.
ideas.title: ArogyaVani
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the AI for Healthcare theme with regional accessibility, following the proven success of SAGACITY's multilingual health awareness approach.

ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade triage app that measures heart rate and vital stress signs using smartphone camera remote photoplethysmography combined with instant multilingual triage.
ideas.title: PulseCheck rPPG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced computer vision with acute healthcare utility, matching the exact winning formula of mediscan-ai.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered clinical training simulator featuring real-time MediaPipe pose tracking for CPR form feedback combined with an interactive AI patient interview.
ideas.title: MediSim CPR Coach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a live, highly engaging interactive demo that physically tracks movement, replicating the grand-prize-winning traits of Clinical-Simulator.

ideas.pitch: A 60-second voice biomarker analysis tool designed to screen for early signs of Parkinson's Disease in regional clinics during routine checkups.
ideas.title: VocalScreen PD
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an impressive specialized audio diagnostic pipeline that can be fully demonstrated live within 60 seconds of interaction, much like Timbre.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and wellness assistant that delivers personalized meal recommendations based on Indian dietary habits, local ingredients, and specific chronic health conditions.
ideas.title: AyurNutri AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on localized daily healthcare and nutrition management, mirroring the winning formula of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant.
